items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: names such as Perdido... King Oliver... have been either names in cultist books, or, uh, names on, on records that we treasure.

ctx.x: Um, tell me about New Orleans when you got here. What did you think?

Uh, well, the first thing we noticed that we recognized, of course, was Canal Street. Uh, it was a big thrill to stand on Canal Street. I think we were on the widest street in the world. Uh, we were staying at the YMCA, as we walked up St Charles, and we came across names such as Perdido, uh, that meant, uh, quite a lot to us, far more than it would to the average tourist. I'd say they'd go completely unnoticed. Uh, we immediately thought in terms of the New Orleans Wanderers, King Oliver, that, uh, it's, uh,…
Tell me about, uh, the bands you've heard. You have heard some bands, you know.
